lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Tala, the tram is stopped beyond the gate. Four people aboard.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: Why will the gate not open?

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: DAWM locked it to protect the pumps. Its map shows nowhere safe to send the pressure.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: Then we find the missing route.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Use the inspection anchor. Wait for its crescent to turn white.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: So down is a setting.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Only inside a marked field. Follow the white seams.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Flood protocol sees you as an obstruction. Disable those skimmers.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: They are doing what the map tells them.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Then we correct the map.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: The gantry is still attached to its rail.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: Change the rail's down; move the bridge.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: The relief channel is still here.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: The new district map dropped its connection.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Upper route is exposed and defended. Lower route is flooded. Both lead to the lock.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: I am taking the lattice.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: I am taking the conduit.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: That charge cell can stun the keeper through its shield.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: The valves bought us more time between surges.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: The keeper is holding the gate. Expose its three seals.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: I can make it fall sideways.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: One down. Its shield follows gravity.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: Last one. Get the district map ready.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Lock released. The gate still needs somewhere safe to send the water.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: The keeper was guarding the pressure lock.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: That missing channel is our outlet.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Scan it first. The last survey is old.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Clear of people. The channel can take this pressure.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: The street is occupied. The pump chamber overloads. The relief channel stays within tolerance.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: The route is restored. I authorize the transfer.

lines.speaker: DAWM
lines.text: RELIEF CHANNEL: VERIFIED / PRESSURE TRANSFER: SAFE / GATE: OPEN

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: Pressure down. Gate open. Four people aboard.

lines.speaker: Tala
lines.text: One missing route nearly trapped them.

lines.speaker: Kest
lines.text: And I found two more.
